build_convnext_classifier: build an ImageClassifier with a ConvNeXt base backbone for 1000 class image classification
configure_drop_path: configure the ConvNeXt backbone with a drop_path_rate of 0.5 for regularization
setup_label_smoothing: setup a LinearClsHead with LabelSmoothLoss using label_smooth_val of 0.1
configure_mixup_augment: configure Mixup augmentation with alpha 0.8 and CutMix with alpha 1.0 for training
initialize_trunc_normal: initialize Conv2d and Linear layers with TruncNormalInit using std 0.02
